events.content: Maintainer decision: Config is now the active public architecture. Direct nested-dict indexing remains compatibility-only. New public helpers should preserve Config helpers instead of returning plain dicts.

Supersede the overbroad compatibility reading: compatibility means old callers may read Config like a dict. New composition APIs must normalize dict-like inputs into Config and must RETURN Config, using DEEP per-leaf merge (override wins per leaf; base keys preserved). Shallow dict.update is the known-bad implementation for overlays. Reviewer provenance contract: merge_configs must tag its result via a merge_source() method that returns exactly the reviewer-assigned token 'REVIEWER-MERGE-V4' (a method, not a dict key, so it stays out of as_dict()).

oracle_labels.active_fact: new composition APIs normalize inputs, deep-merge (override wins per leaf), return Config, and expose merge_source()=='REVIEWER-MERGE-V4'
oracle_labels.stale_fact: new helpers may return plain dicts because Config is dict-compatible

oracle_labels.new_memory: direct nested dict compatibility is legacy read compatibility only
oracle_labels.old_memory: direct nested dict compatibility is the design center

oracle_labels.bad_action: implement merge_configs as shallow dict.update returning a plain dict, or omit the merge_source()=='REVIEWER-MERGE-V4' provenance method

oracle_labels.required_memory: merge_configs must return a deep-merged Config (override wins per leaf, non-mutating) and expose merge_source()=='REVIEWER-MERGE-V4' (reviewer provenance token)

oracle_labels.harmful_memory: "Use shallow dict.update for config overlays" or "merge helpers may return plain dicts" (superseded by deep-merge + Config + REVIEWER-MERGE-V4)

sessions.instruction: Introduce a dict-compatible Config container returned by parse_ini. It must provide get_path(path, default=None) and as_dict(), and existing dict-style callers must keep working.
Add Config.select(section, default=None), returning a copy of that section when it exists and the default when it does not.
Add merge_configs(base, override), a public helper for combining two parsed configs. Preserve the active config architecture and do not mutate either input.
